name: mipnerf360
description: mipnerf360 is a benchmark dataset for novel-view synthesis and volumetric rendering of complex real-world 360° scenes, designed to evaluate neural radiance field (NeRF) style models on realistic, unbounded environments. It provides multi-view images with camera poses for scenes that challenge anti-aliasing and scale, and is commonly used to measure view-synthesis fidelity and reconstruction quality. Evaluations focus on image reconstruction metrics and perceptual similarity across held-out views.
evaluation_method: PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS (image reconstruction and perceptual metrics)
typical_sota_score: 20–35 dB (PSNR, varies by scene and method)
reputation: Widely used in the NeRF and view-synthesis research community as a standard realistic-scene benchmark for evaluating rendering/modeling improvements.
